issues.explanation: Chapter 41 says曹操“收降荆州”, implying the whole region has surrendered, but Chapter 42 then narrates曹操进取江陵 and荆州官民投降. The earlier wording prematurely collapses a later event and makes the handoff temporally inconsistent.
issues.suggested_fix: Change it to“收降襄阳及荆州部分官员” or simply“收降刘琮等人”，leaving江陵及其官民的投降 for Chapter 42.
